title: Flat quasi-compact surjective morphisms are quotient maps
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a flat, quasi-compact, and surjective morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For every subset $W\subseteq Y$, the subset $W$ is open if and only if its inverse image $g^{-1}(W)\subseteq X$ is open.
